messages:
viv_sales: Hey all — Quick request from Nova POC. Need a hosted demo token for their workshop: 11-day life, rotate at day 5, IP allowlist 203.0.115.0/24, audit logs with prompt redaction. They want a short "credential ceremony" doc to send to their ops. Demo in ~36h.

ana_se: We can produce an ephemeral hosted token bound to the workspace and allowlist. Suggest a grace refresh 90 minutes before demo to avoid expiry mid-run.

raj_security: Security asks: redact prompt/response bodies, retention 45 days for this POC, and include a revoke contact + automated webhook to sales. Also we need the internal approval ticket ID before we create.

morgan_ops: Approval ticket NOV-POC-754 exists. I'll create the token now and wire the revoke webhook to both #sales and a sales inbox. Internal CLI (ops only):

```
redwoodctl keys create \
  --workspace nova-poc \
  --owner viv_sales \
  --name nova-poc-workshop-2405 \
  --ttl 11d \
  --rotate-after 5d \
  --pre-demo-refresh 90m \
  --allowlist 203.0.115.0/24 \
  --redact-logs true \
  --audit-retention 45d \
  --notify-webhook https://hooks.redwood.sales/nova/revoke
```

keybot: Created token: key_NOVA2026zz (expires 2026-05-20T14:00:00Z). Rotation scheduled day 5. Pre-demo refresh set. Audit logging enabled (redaction: true).

viv_sales: Please DM the token to me securely. I need a one-paragraph "credential ceremony" I can send to their ops describing handoff, safety kill-switch, and revoke expectations.

raj_security: Ceremony paragraph for customer (one-paragraph): "Redwood will issue a hosted demo token scoped to the Nova POC workspace and constrained to the office CIDR provided. Tokens are time-bound and will be rotated automatically; Redwood also provides an immediate revoke (safety kill-switch) on request or if any security concern is raised. Revoke events are logged and a notification is sent to both Redwood sales and your listed approver; typical time-to-revoke is under two minutes. Re-issuance requires a new approval ticket."

morgan_ops: Added automation: if approval ticket moves to state 'blocked' the system auto-revokes and posts reason to #sales. Revoke CLI (ops): `redwoodctl keys revoke key_NOVA2026zz --reason "sq_blocker"`.

viv_sales: Thanks all — forwarding ceremony and instructions to Nova now. Will update after their smoke test. :lock:
